text:
:= by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact (le_refl (n + 1))
  · have h1 : 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 := by rfl
    have h2 : 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (d - 1) + 2 ^ (d - 1) := by rw [mul_add]
    have h3 : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (d - 1) + 2 ^ (d - 1) := add_le_add_right hd 2 ^ (d - 1)
    exact le_trans h3 h2
    exact le_trans h2 h1
    exact le_trans h1 (le_mul_right (le_of_lt (lt_iff_le_not_le.2 (le_zero_left d))) 2)
